title: Cotton crosses the ocean
hook: How can a fragment in Egypt reveal an Indian Ocean connection?

predict.question: Where were many of these textiles made?

frames.heading: Production
frames.text: Gujarat produces dyed and printed cottons.

reveal: The route is reconstructed from objects and records, not a surviving ship’s track. Gujarati cottons reached Egypt through Indian Ocean and Red Sea connections. Fragments preserved in Egypt’s dry conditions, together with Genizah documents, reveal exchange that a political-border map would miss.
limit: Exact excavation sites for the Met fragments are unknown; sea links are generalized.

sources.section: Production, Genizah documents, Fustat fragments and 1920s–1930s excavations
